comment: Flags use a DIFFERENT dictionary from the ChArUco board (DICT_4X4_50, IDs 0-43) so detections can never collide. Each flag is a rigid strip with two markers; angle is measured from the line joining their centres (base -> tip). Mounting alignment is irrelevant (cancelled by session zero-reference); rigidity is everything.

joint_definitions.comment: Joint angles are differences of flag angles, signed per Figure 2.1.2 (positive CCW, top view, zero roll). Establish the sign mapping for YOUR camera orientation once per setup using a known small positive rotation, then set flip_sign accordingly.
